facts.fact: Estiene 满脑子主意、白兰地与欲望；世界再大，对他而言始终只有一个人那么大——Jehan
facts.anchor: the world was the size of one person, and for Estiene it had always been Jehan

facts.fact: Estiene 在 Clement 的歌声下低唤 Jehan，用手指在他手背上画他们从前的暗号；三个月前两人还定期上床、彼此当秘密
facts.anchor: as if it weren’t three months ago—they were fucking regularly

facts.fact: Estiene 承认他当初停止的理由已不再是好理由
facts.anchor: The reasons I had for stopping aren’t good reasons anymore.

facts.fact: Jehan 说他在二年级末就拿到 Mostau 奖学金，所以离开早已确定；他称之后是三年的确定期，期满便自由回来
facts.anchor: I got the Mostau scholarship at the end of second year.

facts.fact: Jehan 对 Estiene 说：很久以前我就爱上你了，我真以为你知道
facts.anchor: I fell in love with you forever ago. I really thought you knew.

facts.fact: Jehan 提出：Estiene 并未被绑定，若明天一切顺利，没什么能阻止他跟自己去 Fenehaf
facts.anchor: there’s nothing stopping you from coming with me

facts.fact: Estiene 原本的打算是直接进医院最有声望的诊断方向初级职位、开始建职业生涯；此刻这个假设被扫开
facts.anchor: the most prestigious diagnostics-track junior position at the Hospital

facts.fact: Estiene 笑说我改主意了、我绝不让嘴靠近——，随即被 Jehan 拉到床上
facts.anchor: I’ve changed my mind, I’m not putting my mouth anywhere near—
